title: Private tenant: SSO assertion missing subject claim causes RBAC bind failures and audit-event omissions
creator: Sofia Kim
description: Multiple customers running Redwood Private reported intermittent authorization failures and missing audit entries during a KMS key rewrap window. Root cause appears to be SSO assertions that do not include the expected 'sub' claim; our assertion normalization path previously fell back to an empty principal which caused RBAC mapping to fail and downstream audit emission to be suppressed. This ticket tracks the urgent patch, rollout, and reconciliation work.
reproduction_steps: 1) Configure Private cluster with IdP that emits NameID or 'sid' instead of 'sub' for session tokens
2) Trigger KMS key rotation / async rewrap (customer reported during scheduled rewrap)
3) Simulate assertion replay to control plane while metadata cache is being rehydrated
4) Observe requests accepted at connection layer but principal resolution returns empty; RBAC mapping returns NO_MATCH; audit pipeline logs missing tenant_id and suppressed event
mitigation_steps_taken: 2026-03-10 09:12 - Temporary mitigation: oncall toggled 'accept-unknown-principal' safeguard in private clusters to force explicit DENY with a generated audit event (control-plane flag) to avoid silent suppression
2026-03-10 11:03 - Increased KMS-unwrap logging and enabled tracing for assertion parsing path for affected customers
2026-03-10 14:20 - Notified impacted customers with post-incident mitigation steps and ETA for patch
root_cause_analysis: IdP variant sends NameID or 'sid' claim instead of 'sub' in some configured flows
Assertion parser had a fragile assumption: 'sub' always present; fallback path produced empty principal rather than trying other common fields
During KMS key rewrap, the metadata cache rehydration raced with assertion validation leading to a code path that skipped normalized claim extraction
Audit pipeline suppressed events when tenant/principal could not be resolved, resulting in missing audit entries in customer logs
planned_fix: 1) Implement prioritized claim resolution: attempt 'sub' -> 'nameid' -> 'sid' -> 'email' before marking principal missing
2) Add atomic swap for metadata rewrap: snapshot current keyset and apply rewrap behind lock to avoid stale cache window
3) Ensure control plane emits provisional audit events when principal resolution fails (with placeholder tenant_id) and reconcile once principal is resolved
4) Add feature-flagged rollout with heap/integration tests and one-hour canary on affected Dedicated/Private clusters
5) Backfill suppressed audit events where possible using increased KMS unwrap and assertion trace logs
acceptance_criteria: Unit tests covering prioritized claim resolution and fallbacks (>= 90% coverage for assertion parsing module)
Integration test that reproduces rewrap race and demonstrates no audit suppression
Canary run on internal staging Private cluster for 60 minutes with synthetic churn and zero authz-audit gaps
Customer validation with two impacted tenants confirming restored audit events for at least 3 hours post-deploy
Security review signoff on new fallback mapping logic (no escalation of privileges when claims ambiguous)
rollout_plan: A) Merge PR behind feature flag and deploy to staging (private-staging-1)
B) Run e2e repro harness for 30m and confirm logs, then enable canary on one low-traffic customer Private cluster
C) Monitor audit event rates, RBAC match %, KMS unwrap latency for 2 hours
D) If stable, gradually enable feature-flag across affected customers in 15-min increments
E) If regression observed, rollback by disabling feature flag and revert PR
testing_plan: Automated unit tests for claim resolver; fuzz tests for unexpected claim shapes
Integration harness that simulates KMS rewrap and assertion arrival ordering
Chaos test that restarts metadata cache background worker during assertion validation
Manual verification steps for CS/SE: run sample flow, inspect audit log entries (control plane and customer-facing), inspect GitHub PR logs
postmortem_next_steps: Schedule postmortem meeting with CS and affected customers (owners: Sofia Kim, Alicia Chen)
Create automated regressions for assertion permutations observed in the wild
Add a doc to KB describing IdP claim mapping guidance and recommended IdP configuration
Backfill customer audit data where possible and provide export bundle to customers
